Apple Services Restored After Widespread Outage

Apple services including iCloud, the App Store, and Apple Pay experienced a widespread outage that affected users across the US. The services were restored after an internal update. Separately, Chase Bank reported that its operations were back to normal following a disruption caused by a 'bug' that affected transactions.
